name: Image compressor
title: Image Compressor: Compress JPG, PNG and WebP, No Upload
description: Make images smaller without uploading them. Compress JPG, PNG and WebP by quality or to a target size such as 100 KB, in batches. Free and private.
summary: Shrink JPG, PNG and WebP files, or hit a target size like 100 KB.
howTo: Choose your images, drop them on the page, or paste one with Ctrl+V.
Set the quality, or switch to Target file size and type a limit such as 100 KB. The tool finds the best quality that fits.
For phone photos, turn on Also shrink big images. Fewer pixels make a far bigger difference than lower quality.
Hold Hold to see original on the preview to compare, then download one image or all of them as a ZIP.

faq.q: How do I compress an image to 100 KB?
faq.a: Choose Target file size and enter 100. If even the lowest quality is too big, turn on Also shrink big images and lower the longest side, for example to 1600 pixels.

faq.q: Why is my PNG barely smaller?
faq.a: PNG is lossless: it keeps every pixel exactly, so there's little to remove. Save it as WebP to keep transparency at a fraction of the size, or as JPG if it's a photo.
Around 70–80% is hard to tell apart from the original for most photos and often cuts the size by more than half. Below 50% you start to see blocky edges.
